credNotLoaded: Credentials not loaded — please try again
fillRequired: Please fill in the service name, base URL, API key, and model ID
savedButTestFailed: Saved locally, but the connection test failed. Check the base URL, key, and model ID.
saveFailed: Failed to save to the local database: {msg}
testFailedSwitch: Connection test failed — choose another model or contact your admin
tipBranch: Review and summarize the uncommitted changes on branch {branch}
tipReadme: Read {name}'s README and main source files, then give me an overview of the project structure
tipDeps: Check this {lang} project's dependency setup and point out items that can be upgraded or are risky
welcomeSub: MJ Nexus is a local-first AI coding assistant. Next: configure a model → pick a safety tier → choose a digital employee and skills → connect services → pick a project → send your first task.
modelSub: Enter your own API key — credentials are encrypted by the system and stored in the local database (keys never leave this machine). You can also pick a server-shared model (no key needed).
sharedModelDesc: Configured by your admin, no key needed
myKeyDesc: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, stored locally only
noSharedModel: No shared models available on the server. Switch to "My API Key" or contact your admin.
projectSub: MJ Nexus runs commands, reads and writes files, and performs Git operations inside the project directory.
skipProject: Skip, don't create a project yet
firstTaskSub: Pick a suggestion to get started, or just type your own.
readySub: Setup complete. You can adjust everything later in Settings and the Ecosystem Center.
safetySub: The agent runs commands and reads/writes files. Pick a starting point — you can change it anytime in Settings → Security & Sandbox.
safetySafeName: Recommended: ask before each write + write only inside the project (default)
safetySafeDesc: Allowed: read any file; write only inside the current project directory; commands prompt for confirmation by risk level. Blocked: changes outside the project; network commands need explicit approval. Best for most users.
safetyReadonlyDesc: Allowed: read files, search code, view Git status. Blocked: all writes and network access. Good when you want the agent to read code without touching any file.
safetyAutoName: Fewer interruptions: low-risk writes run automatically
safetyAutoDesc: Allowed: low-risk writes run without prompting. Blocked: high-risk commands and writes outside the project still require your confirmation. For users who are comfortable with the tool and want fewer prompts.
safetyNote: Under every preset, high-risk actions (dangerous commands, MCP tools, writes outside the project) still prompt for confirmation — presets never bypass them.
sharedModelOfflineNote: Shared models require a server connection; while offline, configure your own model service.
localModelHint: These model services are already saved on this machine — click one to use it (keys never leave this machine)
localModel: Models already configured on this machine
newProviderHint: Add a model service (saved to the local database)
pickLocalModel: Pick a model on this machine first
localModelTestFailed: Connection test failed — check this service's base URL and key
employeeSub: Pick a digital employee — it sets the role, available tools and default approval tier for your tasks. Optional; you can recruit more from the Ecosystem Center later.
skillsSub: Skills are packaged ways of working (code review, doc rewriting, and more). Pick up to 3 now; change them anytime.
connectorsSub: Connectors let the agent reach external services (databases, docs, GitHub, and more). This step only decides what appears in the available list.
catalogEmpty: Nothing available on this machine yet. Skip for now and configure it later in the Ecosystem Center.
skillPickHint: Selected skills are installed locally when you finish; anything that fails to install is not enabled.
connectorHint: Enabling is not connecting: keys and authorization still go in Ecosystem Center → Connectors. The agent never receives credentials you have not configured.
